test_framework: No test framework - syntax check only
verification_instructions: Run python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())" to verify no syntax errors. All code must remain in a single bot.py file.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Firebase credentials are embedded in bot.py. No Docker setup.
contribution_requirements: Single file architecture - all code goes in bot.py. Must preserve all existing features. Use _b() for bold Unicode button text. Use reply keyboards for main navigation, inline keyboards for actions/confirmations.

key_patterns.fsm_states: UserFlow and AdminFlow StatesGroup classes hold all states
key_patterns.routers: router_global, router_start, router_mail, router_vpn, router_proxy, router_deposit, router_tempmail, router_admin - assembled in build_dp()
key_patterns.firebase_helpers: db_get, db_set, db_update, db_push, db_delete - async wrappers around firebase_admin
key_patterns.handler_pattern: @router_name.message(StateOrFilter) async def handler(message: Message, state: FSMContext)
key_patterns.middleware: AntiSpamMiddleware (rate limiting), AuthMiddleware (user creation, ban check, maintenance mode, force-join)

directory_structure: Single-file project: bot.py (7471 lines), requirements.txt, Procfile, railway.toml
